package.description: AutoIt v3 is a freeware BASIC-like scripting language designed for automating the Windows GUI and general scripting.

en-US.description: AutoIt v3 is a freeware BASIC-like scripting language designed for automating the Windows GUI and general scripting.
en-US.longDescription:
AutoIt v3 is a freeware BASIC-like scripting language designed for automating the Windows GUI and general scripting.
It uses a combination of simulated keystrokes, mouse movement and window/control manipulation in order to automate tasks
in a way not possible or reliable with other languages.
en-US.name: SciTE4AutoIt3
